verdict.rationale: Algolia supports natural-language operation only indirectly. An external AI agent can run its official agent skills to manage search, analytics, recommendations and index configuration (algolia-docs-25, algolia-docs-50), or connect through the official MCP server (algolia-docs-17, algolia-docs-60, algolia-probe-4). There is also 'Build with AI' guidance (algolia-docs-57). Agent Studio's conversational search (algolia-docs-39) is aimed at end-user search experiences, not at operating the product, so it adds little here. missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the dashboard or CLI, detailed docs on which admin operations the MCP/skills cover, hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven operation.
